abs: Proposes the Transformer, a sequence model built entirely on attention instead of recurrence or convolution. It trains faster, parallelizes well, and set new translation benchmarks.
pts: Self-attention lets every token look at every other token in one step.
Multi-head attention captures several kinds of relationships at once.
Training time dropped sharply compared with recurrent models.

t: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
abs: Introduces residual connections that let networks with over a hundred layers train reliably. The approach won ImageNet 2015 and became a default building block.
pts: Layers learn a correction to their input rather than a full mapping.
Skip connections ease the vanishing gradient problem.
Deeper nets finally beat shallower ones in practice.

t: Highly Accurate Protein Structure Prediction with AlphaFold
abs: Presents a neural network that predicts 3D protein structures from amino acid sequences at accuracy close to experimental methods, a long-standing open problem in biology.
pts: Evaluated in the CASP14 blind assessment.
Combines evolutionary data with geometric reasoning.
Opened the door to structure prediction at proteome scale.

t: Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search
abs: Combines policy and value networks with Monte Carlo tree search to create AlphaGo, the first program to defeat a professional Go player on a full board.
pts: Policy network narrows which moves to consider.
Value network estimates who is winning from a position.
Self-play refined the system beyond human game records.

t: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields
abs: Models a scene as a small neural network that maps position and view direction to color and density, then renders novel views by volume rendering from a handful of photos.
pts: Differentiable rendering allows training from images alone.
Produces view-consistent results from new camera angles.

abs: Shows that gradually adding noise to data and learning to reverse the process yields high-quality image generation, a recipe that later powered many text-to-image systems.
pts: Training reduces to predicting the noise at each step.
Sample quality rivaled leading GAN results.
Training is more stable than adversarial approaches.
